approaches.name: Integral cover-lattice recognition
approaches.finding_and_gap: The primitive pullback lattice on X_r differs from the index-two-saturated lattice on Y_r; no unmarked invariance proved.

approaches.name: Intrinsic Lagrangian-sphere recovery
approaches.finding_and_gap: The rational-span hypothesis forces complement discriminants 4 and 1; the hypothesis remains unproved.

approaches.name: Canonical-pencil Hurwitz cancellation
approaches.finding_and_gap: An exact finite central-extension example shows subgroup membership and partial conjugation do not imply Hurwitz equivalence; no quotient of the actual pencil tuples is asserted.

approaches.name: Negative-sphere representability
approaches.finding_and_gap: Both X_3 and Y_3 contain smooth -3 spheres pairing 1 with K; canonical-symplectic representability is not claimed.

approaches.name: Degeneration and relative fillings
approaches.finding_and_gap: Even-r components share a semi-smooth limit despite spin mismatch. The new normal r=3 bridge still needs a relative filling comparison.
